stages.name: Operation Inferno-2
stages.description: The terrain on this battlefield is relatively simple, but beware of enemy Casters. Consider deploying units with high Arts Res to draw their fire or take advantage of the holes on the ground.

stages.name: Operation Cocytus-2
stages.description:
The Possessed Soldiers are launching a vicious two-pronged attack, and we must stay calm if we are to deal with the threat.
<Active Originium>Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly.

stages.name: Operation Starfire-2
stages.description: This war of attrition has sapped us of our energy, but only miserable defeat awaits us should we give up now. Hold on! There must be an opening in the enemy's assault...

stages.name: Operation Erebus-1
stages.description:
A precious yet fragile life. 
<Static Roadblock> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<Ursus Civilian> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.

stages.name: Operation Anemoi-1
stages.description: The enemy is coming thick and fast, in phalanx formation, with a vicious offense, but so long as we hold this choke point, victory should be simple.

stages.name: Operation Anemoi-2
stages.description:
Enemy fireballs cover the whole battlefield. Stay calm under fire and protect yourself.
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

stages.name: Operation Anemoi-3
stages.description:
The enemy has dispatched even more Companion Guards and Shadowblades. Form a defensive line carefully, and we will win a chance at victory.
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

stages.name: Operation Hyades-1
stages.description:
The battlefield's dire terrain will likely be of hindrance to our formation, but it can also effectively curb the enemy. 
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.
<Heat Pump Passage> Periodically deals great damage to any units on it.

stages.name: Operation Hyades-2
stages.description:
Proper timing in clearing the Tattered Pillars will make important changes to the terrain and significantly reduce the challenge of this battle.
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

stages.name: Operation Astrape-2
stages.description:
Large numbers of refugees are pouring toward the safe zone. We need more support!
Allies have greatly reduced cost limit.

stages.name: Operation Pharos-1
stages.description:
Stop the march of the Nachzehrer.
<Originium Pollution> Continuously deals True damage to units on it and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
<Active Originium Storm> Deals True Damage to units in its area every second and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
